descriptionHtml:
Shine bright in our Plus Size Sparkling Sleeveless Leaf Sequin A-Line Formal Evening Dress. Adorned with dazzling leaf sequins, this sleeveless gown exudes glamour and sophistication. The A-line silhouette flatters curvy figures, ensuring confidence and elegance for formal events. Step into the spotlight and sparkle with grace in this stunning evening dress.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is no padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
